sm_top.sm: A ship was reportedly hit in a drone strike off the coast of Libya, prompting threats of reprisal from the Libyan army.
NATO deploys AWACS surveillance aircraft to Poland following Russian missile incursions and airspace violations.
Yemen's Houthis claim responsibility for attacks on a Saudi oil refinery and the Riyadh financial center.
Israeli airstrikes across the Gaza Strip resulted in reported deaths.
Israeli strikes kill people across the Gaza Strip, including officials.
Multiple oil tankers and an LNG carrier were damaged by naval mines and missile attacks in the Strait of Hormuz.
Houthi leadership threatened to strike Jeddah and other Saudi ports in response to regional tensions.
Iran claims its air defenses shot down US drones near the Strait of Hormuz.
A Russian drone strike on an apartment building in the Kyiv region killed at least 14 people.
Sri Lankan and Salvadoran troop deployments and anti-gang security operations in Haiti, including reported casualties among security forces and suspected gang members.
An attack occurred on a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz, prompting warnings to transiting vessels and leaving a crew member dead.
Two Libyan naval officers died from wounds sustained in a Ukrainian drone attack.
An Iranian drone attack in Kuwait resulted in the deaths of two Italian nationals.
Yemen's Houthis claimed an attack on Saudi Arabia's oil facilities.
Yemeni forces targeted Saudi Arabia's Red Sea ports.
Tankers and an LNG carrier were reported struck by mines in the Strait of Hormuz, prompting tighter security orders by Iran.
Russian forces conducted widespread drone and aerial bomb strikes across Ukraine, including the Zaporizhzhia region.
The Prospekt shopping and entertainment center in Kyiv remains open following a Russian ballistic missile strike.
The Saudi-led coalition reports striking a Yemeni port city, while Houthis threaten retaliation.
North Korea's leader Kim Jong Un vowed to build more nuclear weapons and called for a wider deployment of tactical nuclear weapons.
The ICJ ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya people.
A Russian strike on Zaporizhzhia killed two people and wounded dozens, including children.
RSF drone strikes in Sudan's Blue Nile State killed 19 civilians and displaced thousands.
Houthi forces advanced toward Aden, bringing the government stronghold closer to a critical tipping point.
A Ukrainian strike damaged the Kerch Strait Bridge linking Russia and Crimea.
Ukrainian drones struck two oil refineries in Samara, Russia.
Casualties from a Russian drone strike on Kharkiv rose to one dead and six injured.
Communal clashes in Niger State, Nigeria, result in a death toll of 74.
Ukrainian forces struck Savasleyka air base, damaging three MiG-31 and two Su-34 aircraft.
A Russian attack on Bila Tserkva damaged commercial infrastructure and resulted in one fatality.
Russian drone attacks overnight killed 3 people in Kharkiv, damaging a hospital, homes, and the Kharkiv Aviation Institute.
Russian strikes hit Kyiv and seven oblasts, targeting water supply facilities, heating networks, and grain ships.
A Ukrainian drone strike killed 5 people in Zaporizhzhia, while Russian strikes targeted military positions and a cargo ship.
A Ukrainian Flamingo missile strike destroyed a workshop at a key Russian missile factory in Russia.
The Saudi-led coalition launched airstrikes on Sanaa following a Houthi drone attack that wounded 11 in Riyadh.
Ukrainian air defense forces intercepted and shot down 87 Russian attack drones.
Media outlets and hackers report at least 500,000 Russian fatalities on the Ukrainian front.
Houthi forces shelled civilian passenger buses in Yemen, causing 26 deaths.
Iran claims its air defenses destroyed two US drones in the Strait of Hormuz.
Iran launched missile and drone attacks against Bahrain and US bases in the Gulf region.
